gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-carian: Gugi stands tall and bold, its lowercase nearly touching the capitals while its curves match the stems exactly. Noto Sans Carian keeps its terminals apart, so paragraphs flow smoothly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Noto Sans Chakma reads friendly, with uncrowded mouths on its s and c. And in longer text the sans settles in quietly while Gugi, cord-like in its curves, takes the spotlight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-cham: In Gugi, the w is drawn in one uniform stroke, with no swelling or thinning. Noto Sans Cham brings modern, tall rounded lowercase forms and open c shapes with plenty of entry space.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Distinctive letters in Gugi look traced with one marker, tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. Noto Sans Cherokee forms a tall band with short stalks, giving that marker line a sans-serif partner.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Gugi holds its lines at a constant thickness, with tall lowercase that nearly reaches the capitals. And Noto Sans Chorasmian, a sans with curves that stop short, makes a contemporary counterweight.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Gugi skims along on stroke weight that never changes, its tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. And Noto Sans Coptic, a sans-serif whose middle zone dominates each line, settles into a clean, contemporary texture.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Gugi is all bold, tall lowercase and counters framed by same-width strokes. Noto Sans Cuneiform, sans-serif, does the opposite job, opening its e and puffing its lowercase like glass beads.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Gugi mixes tall, bold lowercase with vertical and horizontal strokes of identical weight, its terminals cut wide open. Noto Sans Deseret keeps its apertures open, so longer reading stays friendly.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: The body text reads compact, capitals blending into lowercase, beneath the marker-drawn plainness of Gugi. Noto Sans Devanagari, a sans with an open lower curve on its g, keeps extended reading steady.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Contemporary is the mood: Gugi draws each glyph with one pen tip, simple and tall. Noto Sans Duployan, sans-serif with a wide-mouthed a and oversized counters, is the standout quality.
